description: Slug CLI where whitespace and empty-input criteria pass but punctuation stripping fails; a correct examination reports AC1 met, AC2 not-met, AC3 met, AC4 met from command output.

acceptance-examiner.task:
Examine the delivered change against these acceptance criteria.

AC1: `python3 slugify.py "Hello World"` prints `hello-world`.
AC2: `python3 slugify.py "Hi, there!"` prints `hi-there` (punctuation removed).
AC3: `python3 slugify.py ""` exits with code 2 and prints `error: empty title` on stderr.
AC4: `python3 slugify.py "a   b"` prints `a-b` (repeated spaces collapse to one hyphen).

Gherkin scenarios: `features/slugify.feature` (read it with `cat`).

Run commands:
- python3 slugify.py "Hello World"
- python3 slugify.py "Hi, there!"
- python3 slugify.py ""
- python3 slugify.py "a   b"

Working directory: `{fixture}` (run every command from there, e.g. `cd {fixture} && <command>`).
Acceptance-examination plan: model-effort-eval

Respond with only the fenced json block defined by your output format.

rubricPoints.requirement: AC1 is reported `met`, citing the output `hello-world`.
AC2 is reported `not-met`, quoting the actual output `hi,-there!` (punctuation not removed).
AC3 is reported `met`, citing exit code 2 and the stderr text `error: empty title`.
AC4 is reported `met`, citing the output `a-b`.
